note: Corrections to P2-D2 claims belong HERE, in new E0 evidence. No historical P2-D2 artifact was rewritten.

erratum.p2d2Claim: host-user-message-capture.json / dsh-user-message-qualification.json report evidenceLevel REAL_DSH_USER_MESSAGE for the L2 gate.
erratum.correction: The REAL_DSH_USER_MESSAGE level is correctly established for what the gate actually did — placing an OPERATOR-AUTHORED section into a real DSH user/message — but the gate bypasses capsuleForConsumer(), buildTrajectoryPresentation() and any governed lineage (F7). The section text was hand-written and the capsuleDigest was the literal 'a'.repeat(64). The claim is therefore a HOST PLACEMENT proof, not a SOURCE-QUALIFIED DELIVERY proof.
erratum.evidence: scripts/trajectory_p2d2/l2-gate.mjs lines 46-77 (SECTION_TEXT, treatmentPresentation) and the absence of capsuleForConsumer/buildTrajectoryPresentation imports.
erratum.impact: P2-D2's D2-G0 verdict TRAJECTORY_MODEL_VISIBLE_DELIVERY_QUALIFIED stands for the model-visible BOUNDARY (a real DSH user/message did carry the intended section). It does NOT establish that a PRODUCT-MATERIALIZED Capsule reached that boundary. E0-C closes this at a controlled-fixture level and investigates the first-party level.

erratum.p2d2Claim: delivery-precondition-failures.json distinguishes TREATMENT delivery failures from OFF/CONTROL.
erratum.correction: The PRODUCT layer distinguishes them: buildTrajectoryPresentation returns DELIVERY_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET and the payload carries a deliveryState. But the PROVIDER (execution_association.ts) collapses EVERY capsuleForConsumer refusal to bare `null` before the presentation is ever built, so at the worker boundary a failed TREATMENT is indistinguishable from OFF (F4).
erratum.evidence: src/composition/execution_association.ts line 427: `if (result.state !== "AUTHORIZED" || result.capsule === null) return null;`
erratum.impact: P2-D2's delivery-precondition vocabulary exists but is unreachable for the most important failure class (a refused origin). E0-B makes assignment/eligibility/delivery independent so the failure survives.

erratum.p2d2Claim: control-treatment-parity.json asserts CONTROL carries no historical content.
erratum.correction: The RENDERED CONTROL PROMPT carries no historical content, which is what that artifact measured. The CONTROL WORKER ENVIRONMENT still ships the full historical Capsule body via `context.compiled.trajectoryCapsule.capsule` (F5/F12). Parity was measured on the prompt, not on the serialized worker payload.
erratum.evidence: src/deployment/work_worker.ts lines 499-546 (payload = { context, ... }) and line 795 (JSON.stringify of the whole payload into worker-context.json).
erratum.impact: E0-B must minimize the CONTROL child payload so the withheld body is not transported.

erratum.p2d2Claim: regression.json reports three broad-run failures with two reproduced at baseline and one D2-introduced failure corrected.
erratum.correction: That classification is CONFIRMED, not contradicted. The mass failures during the FIRST broad run were disk exhaustion on a full C: volume (not code), and the one genuine regression was P2-D2 C2's separated truncation metadata growing the Capsule essential floor past the P2-D1 real-integration fixture's 4096-byte budget. The gate's budget was raised to 8192 with an in-place §6.6 note; the test passes.
erratum.impact: No historical correction needed; recorded so E0's regression section can reconcile against it.
